title: Debt MF bought Jun-2020, redeemed Jan-2024 (> 36 months, before 23-Jul-2024): LTCG 20 % with CII indexation
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.2(42A) (pre-Finance (No.2) Act 2024): unlisted MF units (non-equity) short-term if held not more than 36 months
Income-tax Act 1961 s.48 second proviso and Explanation (iii)/(v): indexed cost = cost x CII(year of transfer) / CII(year of acquisition)

CII (base 2001-02 = 100, CBDT Notification No. 44/2017 dated 5-Jun-2017 and annual notifications): FY 2020-21 = 301, FY 2023-24 = 348 (values confirmed; the specific notification numbers - recalled as No. 32/2020 for 301 and No. 21/2023 dated 10-Apr-2023 for 348 - were NOT verified in this session)

Income-tax Act 1961 s.112(1)(a) (pre-Finance (No.2) Act 2024): 20 % on LTCG after indexation; the 10 % no-indexation proviso applies only to listed securities other than units -> not available for MF units
Health and Education Cess 4 % (Finance Act 2023 s.2)

disposals[0].tax_cost.reason: The engine does not model indexation (fincalc.tax rule 'other-unlisted-pre2024', status 'uncertain': 'LTCG 20 % WITH indexation, which is not modelled (the unindexed gain is shown)'; caveat 'Indexation for transfers before 23-Jul-2024 is not modelled' on the tax view). The hand derivation applies s.48 second proviso with CII 301 -> 348. The engine overstates the gain, i.e. errs towards more tax, and says so on the rule and the tax view.

fy[2024].tax.reason: 20 % of the unindexed 9,900 instead of the indexed 5,200 (needs indexation: not modelled)

fy[2024].total.reason: tax + cess on the unindexed gain
